status: 이동기에 드물게 찾아옴, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만
summary: 이동기에 드물게 찾아오는 종으로, 2009년 4월 소청도에서 처음 기록되었고 지금까지 국내 기록은 10건 미만이다. 국내 기록은 모두 4월에 서해와 제주의 섬에서 나왔다. 중국의 온대 산지 숲에서 번식한다.

points.en: pale median crown stripe between dark lateral crown stripes

art.subject: Claudia's Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus claudiae), adult (sexes alike) in spring: a pale greyish-yellow median crown stripe between dark greyish-olive lateral crown stripes that are darkest towards the nape; a long yellowish-white supercilium; a dark olive eye-stripe; upperparts greyish-green, the wings greener, with two clear pale yellowish wing-bars, the lower one on the greater coverts broader; underparts silky greyish-white with at most a faint yellowish tinge on the flanks and vent; outer tail feathers with white on the inner webs; bill with a bright orange lower mandible, the upper mandible dusky along its ridge; dark eye; pale yellowish-brown legs.
art.pose: clinging to the side of a tree trunk, side view, head pointing the same way as the body, wings closed
art.scene: mixed woodland on a Korean offshore island during spring migration in May, dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult in spring, side view clinging to a tree trunk, head pointing the same way as the body: pale median crown stripe between dark greyish-olive lateral crown stripes darkest at the rear, long yellowish-white supercilium, dark eye-stripe, fine bill with an orange lower mandible, olive-green upperparts, two yellowish wing-bars, whitish underparts
adult in spring, side view perched on a twig: olive-green upperparts with two yellowish wing-bars, whitish underparts, pale median crown stripe, long pale supercilium, orange lower mandible
art.build: A small, compact leaf warbler, smaller than a sparrow and a little smaller than an Eastern Crowned Warbler, with a fairly large head. No crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Bill fine and pointed, shorter than the head, with an orange lower mandible. Legs slender, pale yellowish-brown. Tail short and square. Often clings to tree trunks and the undersides of branches like a nuthatch while feeding.
avoid: Do not paint a single wing-bar with a yellow vent contrasting with a white belly; that is Eastern Crowned Warbler (Phylloscopus coronatus).
Do not paint a bright lemon crown stripe or a yellow rump band (Pallas's Leaf Warbler).
Do not make the lateral crown stripes black; they are dark greyish-olive.
Do not paint bright yellow underparts.
